    - If I stand up in council and say the patrols are too thin, every chieftain will nod, and every one will say their own family is managing. Then nothing changes.

Have a quiet word with my sister [Zirra](../npcs/zirra_uskari.md), with [Ulm](../npcs/ulm_kragvar.md) by the fire, and with [Odda](../npcs/odda_brenna.md). Then tell me.
    - Quietly. If it sounds like a council, they will answer like one.

    - A quiet word with [Zirra](../npcs/zirra_uskari.md), [Ulm](../npcs/ulm_kragvar.md) and [Odda](../npcs/odda_brenna.md) about the patrols.
    - Zirra said ask her later. Ulm said the fire does not care who feeds it. Odda said it should be asked over food. Hm.
    - None of them said no, *Player*. In this town that is closer to yes than you would think. Thank you. I will remember who answered and how.
    - My brother sent you to ask about the patrols. He thinks I will not see through that. I raised him; I see through everything he does.
    - Tell him to ask me again later, when I have something to say that I can stand to say. He will understand. Or he will not, and I will have to explain, which I would hate.
    - Sit if you want. The fire does not mind. The patrols? I hear everything said in this hall, and everything not said too.
    - Every family brings wood for this fire and nobody asks whose wood burns brightest. The patrols should be the same. Tell Hask that. He knows already. He sits up with me after councils.
    - A quiet word? From Hask, through you. That is like him: he never asks for anything in the open.
    - The families will say it, but not in a council hall with their chieftains watching. Over food, maybe. Over a long night, certainly. Tell him that, and tell him the Brenna will host it whenever he likes.
